Scan the tote, scan the location (ADR 0054): the bin becomes the tote's logical location. In one transaction the destination is occupied by the contents' eaches, the source bin released, every stock unit of the tote moved, `LocationRecorded` raised per unit, `BinStockLevelChanged` for both bins and `ToteStowed` published. The first stow of a new tote only places it. Into the bin it is already in, nothing changes. A tote holding reserved stock is 409 `tote-reserved`: each allocation names its pick bin (ADR 0025). An `AutomatedStorage` bin accepts a tote: it holds container stock only.

Behind the Idempotency-Key middleware like every other POST (ADR 0018).
